<h1 align="center">ggchangepoint</h1>
<p align="center"><img src="man/figures/logo.png" height="139" alt="ggchangepoint hex sticker" /></p>

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/PursuitOfDataScience/ggchangepoint/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/PursuitOfDataScience/ggchangepoint/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

<!-- badges: end -->

<p align="center"><b>Find where a time series changed with any of 50 methods, and get the same tidy, plottable answer from every one.</b></p>

## 🔍 One series, one call, one picture

```{r nile, fig.height = 3, fig.alt = "Annual Nile flow 1871 to 1970 with a changepoint at 1898 and its confidence interval"}
library(ggchangepoint)
fit <- cpt_detect(Nile, method = "smuce")
fit$changepoints
autoplot(fit, show_ci = TRUE)
```

Five detectors built on different ideas agree:

```{r compare}
ggcpt_compare_table(Nile, methods = c("smuce", "not", "wbs", "mosum",
                                      "strucchange"))
```

## 🧰 Then ask the next question

| You want to know | Call |
| :- | :- |
| How big was the change? | `cpt_effect(fit)` |
| Did anything change in a year I already had in mind? | `cpt_test_at(Nile, when = 1899)` |
| Should I believe this count? | `cpt_assumptions(fit)` |
| Which method suits my data? | `cpt_recommend(noise = "autocorrelated")` |
| Counts, 0/1 outcomes, waiting times? | `cpt_detect(x, family = "poisson")` |
| When did a regression's slope break? | `cpt_detect(y ~ x, data = d, method = "strucchange")` |
| What can each of the 50 methods do? | `cpt_methods()` |

## 🚀 Setup

1. `install.packages("ggchangepoint")`
2. `ggchangepoint::cpt_install_engines(c("core", "regression"))` adds the engines this page uses (`"all"` for every one; three ship with the package).
3. `cpt_detect(your_series)`, then `autoplot()` the result.

## ⚠️ What will bite you

| Trap | Fix |
| :- | :- |
| `pelt`, `binseg` and `fpop` assume unit noise: on raw Nile flows `pelt` reports `r nrow(suppressWarnings(cpt_detect(Nile, method = "pelt"))$changepoints)` changepoints | The package warns. Standardise, or use `change_in = "meanvar"` |
| Autocorrelated noise makes spurious changepoints in every engine | `cpt_assumptions(fit)` checks; `cpt_robustness(fit)` re-runs under another noise model |
| A p-value at a location the data chose is too small | `cpt_test_at()` at a date fixed in advance is exact |
| Missing values are refused | `na_action = "omit"` keeps the original positions |
